pull_request.title: Calorimeter: assess hardware realism and missing detector description
pull_request.head: codex/calorimeter-description-assessment
pull_request.body:
## Executive summary

ODD already describes the calorimeter sampling layers and logical cells. To make nODD as physically explicit as its tracker, we need to describe the hardware that holds, cools, powers and reads out those layers. The maintained nODD assembly currently contains the beam pipe and tracker; a complete calorimeter hardware baseline is still to be established.

The largest gaps are physical sensor/tile modules and cassettes, load-bearing supports, cooling circuits, electronics and power distribution, service routes, and their interfaces to the new inner solenoid. The inherited copper-rich HCAL PCB mixture also needs a hardware/material justification. Cryostat requirements depend on the chosen technology: silicon/scintillator calorimeters need an operating and cooling design, while the superconducting solenoid needs an explicit cryogenic vessel and service system.

The proposed sequence is to agree the technology, operating conditions, material ledger and shared interfaces; design one realistic ECAL cassette and one HCAL cassette; then build sectors and complete barrel/endcap assemblies with reproducible geometry, mass and material checks. This PR supplies the assessment and that staged plan. Calorimeter response, reconstruction, jets and particle flow follow as a separate programme.

## Assessment and evidence

Assess the physical calorimeter description needed to bring nODD to tracker-level component detail. DES-027 distinguishes ODD's explicit sampling model, nODD's proposed envelopes, and the maintained beam-pipe/tracker assembly, which currently has no nODD calorimeter factory/configuration entry point.

The pinned static audit records ECAL48×5.05 mm and HCAL36×51 mm stacks, materials/readouts and distinct barrel/endcap polygon conventions. It identifies a major normalization question: HCAL's 16 mm copper-rich PCB mixture per layer totals 290.924 g/cm² normal areal mass. Logical segmentation also does not supply physical sensor/tile tiling or electronics packages.

The report provides an in-depth prioritized gap matrix for modules/cassettes, load-bearing supports, cooling, powering/readout, service corridors, environmental/cryostat ownership, magnetic steel and forward/integration interfaces. Public ATLAS/CMS engineering references inform hardware categories. A staged C0–C5 programme proceeds from operating/interface/material contracts through representative ECAL/HCAL cassettes and sectors to complete native geometry evidence. Performance, jets and particle-flow/software updates are deferred.

Validation: four audit arithmetic/accounting controls passed; seven source files match pinned ODD revision c167363; public v6.0.2 ECAL/HCAL file bytes are identical; registered PDF hashes match. Project records, session logs, token-site build, document links and persisted hashes passed. No new dependencies, production geometry, technology adoption or design sign-off. Exact active-turn token counters remain unknown in the paired journal.

Design: `docs/design/DES-027-calorimeter-description-assessment.md`; reproducible source inventory: `docs/validation/DES-027/odd-inventory.json`; tools: `tools/calorimeter_audit/`. Companion 3 T solenoid proposal provides separate dimensions for joint interface review.

- [x] Updated scientific project tracking and preserved DRAFT/human approval boundaries.
- [x] Ran relevant controls, session validation, source/artifact checks and token-site build; recorded limitations.
- [x] Recorded exact evidence revisions in project records and paired journals.

Companion: [PR #64 — 3 T tracker solenoid baseline](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/64).
